data.spec: Root owns apps/agent/office/{agent,conversation,environment_queries,room_service,legacy,api,deps}.py for open-ended live conversations. Live Anthropic input will go to general Claude agent before procurement/sensor/room dispatch; Claude selects read-only office/sensor/room tools or submits requests through existing validated procurement boundaries. Explicit mock test mode remains separate; no live-to-mock error fallback, no firmware changes. Existing /api/input, device-event, exact-quote approvals remain compatible; completed information is resolved, not needs_clarification; transcript follow-ups allowed for informational/clarification conversations, never to mutate quoted approvals. Teammate maintenance-whatsapp work: please avoid overlapping these core files; existing ticket and notification hooks retained.
